zara: Planning a blue->green traffic shift for service-embed in eu-west on 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC. Steps: shadow 4% (10m) -> canaries 2% -> 12% -> 40% -> 100%. Drain 120s. Rollback criteria below. Any objections?
piotr: ack. We'll need to ensure LB cookie format compatibility and header-based pinning.
routerops: router cookie preserved, but cookie schema must match across versions. Recommend a preflight log-scan.
zara: runbook: 1) start shadow 4% for 10m to populate caches and compare responses, 2) smoke curl and sample payload diff, 3) step canaries.
deploy-bot: scheduled shift id shift-20260324-0200 for service-embed. Cmd: `/shift run --id shift-20260324-0200 --steps 2,12,40,100 --drain 120 --shadow 4 --auto-rollback true`
ops-oncall: I'll be on duty 01:50-03:10 UTC, assigned.
piotr: observability checks: p95, 5xx%, tokenization errors, cookie-decode errors, downstream queue lag.
zara: rollback triggers: p95 > 250ms sustained 5m OR 5xx > 1.2% sustained 3m OR cookie-decode errors spike OR OOM. Auto-rollback enabled.
deploy-bot: shadow started (ts 1717901290). Running small diff harness to compare outputs for 1k sample prompts.
deploy-bot: shadow results: diff rate 0.8%, cookie warnings 0. No user-facing errors. Proceeding to 2% canary in 10m.
deploy-bot: canary 2% live (ts 1717901530). metrics: p95=88ms, 5xx=0.1%. smoke passed.
piotr: grabbing logs. Noticing occasional cookie deserialization warnings tied to green instances (v4.1). Tagging #cookie-parse.
deploy-bot: advancing to 12% (ts 1717901670).
deploy-bot: ALERT: cookie-decode errors jumped to 2.1% in last 2m; auto-rollback triggered. Rolling back to blue 100% (rb id rb-20260324-0200) (ts 1717901745).
ops-oncall: rollback confirmed. routing restored to blue 100%. Incident INC-20260324-01 created, traces archived s3://redwood-incidents/2026/03/24/embed-shift-0200.
zara: investigating. initial hypothesis: serializer change in green (v4.1) incompatible with older node codepath.
piotr: reproduced locally. Patch: defensive cookie-parser and version pin in router cookie. Will open PR.
routerops: holding further shifts until cookie schema finalized. Also recommend deploy-bot enforce a session-version gate pre-shift.
deploy-bot: note: shadow diff didn't catch because shadow bypassed legacy decode codepath. Need to extend shadow to emulate real client cookie flows.
zara: agreed. Action items: (1) add session-version gate to deploy-bot, (2) extend shadow verification to include cookie round-trip tests and header permutations, (3) document change in release notes and runbook. I'll open PRs and schedule a retry. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
